text: 6 points Let G be a directed, weighted graph with no cycles. A student tries to update the pseudo-code to Dijkstra’s algorithm so that if find the longest path from vertex S to all other vertices in G. The update uses a MAX priority queue instead of a MIN priority queue, and extracts the Max instead of the Min. For all vertices v in G, set v.d =INF Set s.distance = 0 and s.visited = TRUE Add s to the Max Priority Queue. while Q # empty u = Extract-max(Q) for each v in Adj[u] ifv.d < w.d+wu,v) Increase-Key(Q, v, u.d + w(u,v)) v.parent = u Does this procedure correctly set the maximum path length from vertex S to all other vertices in G? Justify your answer.
